name: Hyperbolic Boids
description: 3D boids flocking in hyperbolic space H3, simulated and ray-traced intrinsically. 256 swallows (up to 512) and two predators live on the hyperboloid in an rgba32f Feedback: neighbour distances acosh(-<p,q>), directions from the log map, velocities parallel-transported before averaging, geodesic steps with the exponential map. Rendered by geodesic ray casting: bird SDFs in each boid's normal coordinates with iridescent thin-film shading, screen-projected geodesic trails, the {4,3,5} honeycomb walked by Lorentz reflections, the ideal boundary, bloom, streaks, chromatic aberration, vignette and grain. Reacts to music (the flock breathes on the beat). Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Flock, Camera, Look, Colour, Post and Music.

data.text:
# Hyperbolic Boids
Reynolds flocking in hyperbolic 3-space H3, simulated and ray-traced intrinsically.
- Boids live on the hyperboloid <p,p> = -1 (Minkowski), velocities are tangent vectors (<p,v> = 0).
- Neighbours: distance acosh(-<p,q>), direction from the log map, velocities parallel-transported to p before averaging.
- Step: exponential map p' = cosh(s) p + sinh(s) v, renormalised every frame.
- Rays are geodesics too: the {4,3,5} honeycomb shows five cubes around every edge, impossible in flat space.
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Flock, Camera, Look, Colour, Post and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Boid sim
One rgba32f / nearest Feedback holds the whole state (526 x 16 texels): per boid position, velocity, up vector, wing phase / effort / panic / hue and a 12-step trail history; plus globals (clock, flock centre, orbit camera, camera folded into the honeycomb cell, attractor). dt = clamp(t - t_prev, 0, 0.1) comes from the stored clock.

## Trails
Projects every trail into screen space once per frame (after the sim, before the scene). Geodesics are straight in the camera's Klein model, so each history segment is an exact straight screen segment. Also writes a screen box per boid that the scene uses to cull candidates.

## Scene
Per pixel: cull boids by box, sphere-trace bird SDFs in each boid's normal coordinates along the geodesic ray, iridescent thin-film shading lit from an ideal point, halos, trails, honeycomb wires (Lorentz reflections between cells) and the ideal boundary. Rendered to a 1600x1000 target.

## Bloom
Bright pass of the scene at 320x200 and 96x60, blurred and added back, plus a horizontal anamorphic streak.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music x smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, level).
- Beat: the flock breathes - separation swells up to +60% on each beat (BeatEnvelope ad), and glow flares up to +50%.
- Kick: spines, predator eyes, halos, trails and lattice vertices flash (u_kick x drive, inside the scene).
- Bass: trails brighten up to +60% and the flock speeds up to +20%.
Beat-phase couplings (separation swell, glow flare) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (Beat.gate / BeatEnvelope gate: fade, u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (kick flashes, bass trails and speed) are not.

## Post
Chromatic aberration on the scene target, bloom added, vignette and film grain.

data.label: Music reactivity
data.description: 0 = ignore the music. The flock breathes on the beat, flashes on the kick, speeds up on the bass.

data.label: Separation
data.description: Weight of steering away from close neighbours.

data.label: Alignment
data.description: Weight of matching the neighbours' heading.

data.label: Cohesion
data.description: Weight of steering toward the neighbours' centre.

data.label: Spacing
data.description: Separation radius: how close boids may get.

data.label: Containment
data.description: Pull toward the slowly wandering attractor.

data.label: Trail length
data.description: Seconds of position history in each trail.

data.label: Camera speed
data.description: Orbit speed of the camera around the flock.

data.label: Camera distance
data.description: Scales the camera distance from the flock.

data.label: Lattice
data.description: Brightness of the {4,3,5} honeycomb wireframe (0 = off).
